title: Preserve conversation scroll offset across workspace tab switches
outcome: Switching from one workspace tab to another and then returning changes the conversation viewport offset. The previously visible message/position must remain stable; tab activation must not re-run tail attachment, stale geometry restoration, or history navigation against the inactive pane. Diagnose the tab/pane lifecycle and preserve a stable viewport anchor across tab switches, including virtualized height changes.
acceptance: Switching A -> B -> A restores the same visible conversation position without jumping; attached-to-tail panes remain attached while detached/history panes retain their anchor; incoming messages and measurement changes while inactive do not corrupt restoration; focused regression tests cover tab switching for detached and tail-attached panes; relevant UI gates pass.
